CustomField.description: BR-17, PD-14. Whether Leads in this segment may be qualified as MQL. SYNTHETIC BASELINE: the eligible set was authored for reproducible demonstration of lifecycle governance, not validated with a client. Lives here rather than in its own type because it is a property of the segment, and the segment is already defined once in this record. Unchecking withdraws a segment from marketing qualification without a deployment and without deleting the band.
